I am old now, 57 years, and I have been farming this land my whole life without going to school. This maize plot is small, only half a hectare, but the soil here in Amhara is good if rains come well in meher season. I will get some DAP and urea from the cooperative if they bring it in time, but never enough — I will also spread the manure from my oxen and cattle on the plot before ploughing. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest because hybrid seed is expensive and not always available, and my sons and I will do most of the work with the ox-plough, though at weeding and harvest I may call one or two neighbors for a few days.
